svg.aria-label: twr in use: the user asks the orchestrator for two threads, answers a permission with allow ratelimit, both threads report back, then the user sends ratelimit a follow-up and it reports again

g.text: This is your conversation with the orchestrator.
Tell it what you want done: it starts worker threads, steers them
and reports back. What you type always goes to it.
To talk to a worker directly, select its card (Tab) and press Enter
twice (or double-click it, or /open <thread>); Esc comes back here.
